name: wondering-mods
description: Three Claude Code mods: a sub-agent pane that also shows Codex runs, a quick-button toolbar, and a usage footer. Chinese UI.

plugins.name: agent-watch
plugins.description: Sub-agent status, activity and elapsed time above the prompt, Codex runs included.

plugins.name: session-toolbar
plugins.description: Quick buttons above the prompt: 进度, 交接, 压缩, 撤回, 旁问, 收尾.

plugins.name: session-usage
plugins.description: Plan usage, prompt cache and context in the prompt footer, with details on click.
